GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (31 May 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1711)
APO 500
31 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Japanese Government dated 6 Nov 46, file AG 000.5 (6 Nov 46)LS-R, (SCAPIN 1317), wherein the Japanese Government was directed to deliver one NAGAMURA, Mitsugo, 2nd Lieutenant, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said NAGAMURA's name for the reason that NAGAMURA is in custody in Shanghai. This name appears as the eighth name on Page No. 3 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
